source_refs.note: Topic 1.12 as printed: network performance, Network Bandwidth, Network Latency, Causes of Network Delay and the Class Activity (PDF 19, printed 14).

blocks.text: Network performance means how well a network works. It shows the speed and quality of data transfer. Good performance allows fast and smooth communication. Poor performance causes slow internet and delays. Network performance depends on many factors, such as bandwidth and latency.

Network bandwidth is the amount of data sent in a given time. It shows how much data a network can carry. Bandwidth is usually measured in Mbps. Higher bandwidth means faster data transfer. More devices use more bandwidth. Low bandwidth can cause slow internet speed.

Network latency is the time taken by data to travel. It is the delay between sending and receiving data. Latency is measured in milliseconds. Low latency means faster response. High latency causes lag and delay. Online games and video calls need low latency.

Network delay happens due to many reasons. Too many users can slow the network. Poor-quality cables can cause delay. Long distance between devices increases delay. Network congestion affects data speed. Hardware problems also cause network delay.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Identify possible causes of delay in a given scenario.
